content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial is for missing required prior authorization; silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Claim data are correct, so resubmission would not remedy the denial, and the unmet deductible alone does not establish patient liability for this authorization denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table, making it the next appropriate route despite weak documentation.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
